title: A gate's timed-out child outlives its shell inside the factory container
description:
FOUND 2026-09-23 by the same smoke run (run_0d2edef252834a40b89deabbd0ffec69). Inside the factory container:

    --- FAIL: TestAGateThatTimesOutTakesItsChildrenWithIt (3.31s)
        gate_kill_unix_test.go:64: the gate's child (pid 13680) outlived the timeout that killed its shell

It passes on the Mac. So either the gate's process-group kill does not reach the child in the container, or the child is left as an unreaped zombie that the test reads as alive (a container whose PID 1 does not reap is the usual cause). The first is a real gate defect - a timed-out gate leaving work running in a shared container - and the second is a test that cannot tell dead from reaped. Find out which before fixing; do not relax the assertion to get it green.

Absorbed into xte: it gates xte's done for the same reason as its sibling - every cloud gate runs in the container.
